extraction.notes: Starting line and FFO/Core FFO lines taken from the reconciliation on printed page 10 (seq 13); AFFO lines from the AFFO table on printed page 18 (seq 21), which starts from NAREIT FFO (17,893), not Core FFO. The company's Core AFFO (21,592) is a second adjusted measure that the schema cannot hold: its adjustments after AFFO are non-share-based severance 340, relocation 186, structuring 60, transformation costs 2,900 (AFFO-table version), write-off of pursuit costs 40, and cash loss on extinguishment 0; it reconciles 18,066 + 3,526 = 21,592. Not recorded in core fields because core_total refers to Core FFO. Classification judgments: transformation costs mapped to severance_restructuring; relocation expense mapped to 'other'; the non-real estate D&A of debt costs line combines non-RE depreciation and debt cost amortization, mapped to non_re_depreciation; lease intangible amortization mapped to 'other'. Non-cash fair value interest expense and cash loss on extinguishment print as dashes (zero). Per-share check: 17,893/87,840 = 0.20 matches. Core FFO 21,527/87,840 = 0.245 would round to 0.25, but reported 0.24 reproduces only after deducting the allocation to participating securities of (70): (21,527-70)/87,840 = 0.244, so the company's per-share figure uses that allocation. AFFO per share is not reported. AFFO subtracts recurring capital improvements and leasing costs, so recurring capex disclosure is null.
